type.description: This is the type of the message. Send "say" message to make the assistant say something.

interruptAssistantEnabled.description:
This is the flag for whether the message should replace existing assistant speech.

@default false

content.description: This is the content to say.

endCallAfterSpoken.description: This is the flag to end call after content is spoken.

interruptionsEnabled.description: This is the flag for whether the message is interruptible by the user.
